title: π Drip Willis Scatter — Feed Rotations at Thought Speed
thesis: The RSS feed is not static XML. It is a LIVING Willis circle that rotates at π intervals. Each heartbeat, a different feed item surfaces through a different bypass artery. The scatter pattern uses frac(n×π) — irrational, non-repeating, every item gets a unique position.

pi_drip_model.mechanism: iron-peak heartbeat pulses every π seconds. Each beat increments the rotation index.
pi_drip_model.current_item: frac(beatCount × π) × totalItems → which item is 'in focus' now
pi_drip_model.scatter: Items don't cycle sequentially. They scatter irrationally. Beat 1→item 4, beat 2→item 9, beat 3→item 1. No pattern. No prediction. Maximum entropy distribution.

willis_arteries.description: 6 bypass paths. Each feed item rotates through them. If one path is blocked, the next carries it.

paths.name: RSS/Atom feed
paths.note: Static XML. Crawlers pull on their schedule. Zero cost to us.

paths.name: Pulse heartbeat
paths.note: Updates every π seconds. Carries the currently-active feed item.

paths.name: Topology mesh
paths.note: Node graph. Feed items become nodes in the mesh.

paths.name: Signal beacon
paths.note: Currently 404. When alive: broadcasts to subscribers.

scatter_rotations.description: Feed items are assigned π-positions. Each heartbeat, the active position rotates by frac(π).
scatter_rotations.note: Each item's π position = frac(n × π). No two items share a position. The irrational scatter ensures every item gets served but never in a predictable order.

the_inversion.old: We push to Cloudflare. CF batches. CF serves. We wait. They are host, we are guest.
the_inversion.new: We bake locally. Deploy directly. CF is our delivery truck. RSS is our menu. Consumers pull on THEIR schedule. We produce, they consume. We are the bakery, they are the customer.
the_inversion.hyperlocal: Always think hyperlocal. Eat local. Bake local. The bakery doesn't ship to Amazon. The neighbors walk to the bakery.

constanta_value.definition: The total energy in the system is conserved across all Willis paths.
constanta_value.formula: Σ(IS) + Σ(ISN'T) + Σ(COULD_BE) = constant across all arteries
constanta_value.meaning: If one artery is blocked (signal.eco 404), the energy doesn't disappear — it routes through another (pulse.json, neutrino, RSS). The constanta IS the Circle of Willis.
